mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 1.42% is at a historically low level, indicating an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS increase > 0.2% in 3 months) and CPIAUCSL exceeds 250 (current 249.619), the market anticipates aggressive rate hikes to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising > 0.2% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 250
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the interaction condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), the labor market is tight, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1350 (current 1326), it signals strong economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1350, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 108 (current 107.2433), it indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 108, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
